title: Anna's Birthday Party
text:
Anna has a birthday party on Saturday. She invites her friends Tom and Ola to her house. She writes the invitations on blue paper. The party starts at four o'clock.

Tom likes the idea, but he has a football match in the morning. Ola says yes at once. She wants to bring a cake. Anna is happy because her friends are coming.

questions.text: What colour is the paper for the invitations?
What does Ola want to bring to the party?
How does Anna feel about her friends coming to the party?
What can we guess about Tom?
options: He might come to the party after his match.

vocabulary.definition: written cards that ask people to come to an event
a game in which two teams or people compete
to take something with you to a place

paragraph_translations: Ania ma urodziny w sobotę. Zaprasza do swojego domu koleżanki Tomka i Olę. Pisze zaproszenia na niebieskim papierze. Przyjęcie zaczyna się o czwartej.
Tomkowi podoba się ten pomysł, ale rano ma mecz piłki nożnej. Ola od razu mówi tak. Chce przynieść tort. Ania się cieszy, bo jej przyjaciele przychodzą.
